resources.string: Who signed it, and was it changed?
Not changed since it was signed, and the key was valid then.
Not changed since it was signed, and the key is valid today.
The file says %1$s, but that comes from the signer\'s own clock.
This signature can only be checked until %1$s\'s key expires on %2$s, or sooner if it is cancelled. After that, ask for a newly signed file.
%1$s has no electronic signature in it, so there is nothing to check.
If someone sent it as signed, ask them for the signed file: a .cms, or the PDF they signed.
This .cms holds only the signatures. To check them, choose the document they sign: %1$s.
